src: Written by hand for 0.48 (EL logic), from the 0.48 design spec section 6 and the approved Stage table; earlab_items_test section T also checks the regular metres against music21's TimeSignature (beat count, split of one beat, classification).
fields: sig; rung where the cell first appears; label on the answer; kind simple|compound|irregular; beats = beat clicks per bar; split = clicks per beat (0: counted in quavers); bar_beats = bar length in beats at the drawn tempo; accents per beat click (2 downbeat, 1 secondary accent, 0 beat); group = unequal beats (in crotchets for 5/4, quavers for 7/8)
